title: A cheap proxy for prime-factor fragmentation
pitch: Generate cheap random fragment sizes that reproduce the limiting logarithmic factor sizes of prime predecessors.

title: A threshold for rare resonance bursts
pitch: Choose decay and resonance strengths so an exact integer-radian impulse stream has a finite lifetime total.

title: Cubic interference with a persistent hidden bias
pitch: Show a visible cumulative bias hiding inside seemingly irregular cubic interference patterns.

title: Periodic arithmetic islands with a connectivity certificate
pitch: Build a repeating arithmetic terrain and certify whether its traversable regions wind forever or form finite islands.

title: Arithmetic textures with fixed-shift decorrelation
pitch: Inspect a deterministic binary texture with arithmetic structure and asymptotically vanishing fixed-shift correlations.

title: An extra dimension straightens a polynomial world
pitch: Sample a warped polynomial surface exactly, then expose the extra variable that makes its coordinate system polynomially straight.

title: Fit a procedural field one row at a time
pitch: Fit row-arranged control points with a small polynomial solver that preserves every row already fitted.

title: Irregular fractal worlds with a guaranteed supply of distances
pitch: Explore how multiscale fractal density affects a map's all-pairs distance histogram.

title: Binary probes with almost perfectly flat spectra
pitch: A binary probe could deliver nearly equal spectral power at every frequency if a practical theorem-derived sign sequence can be produced.

title: Fair local odds, only three possible worlds
pitch: A generator can give every pairing equal local odds while producing only three whole-map outcomes.

title: Morph convex rooms without collapsing their volume
pitch: Morph symmetric convex rooms with multiplicative support bounds and a guaranteed volume floor.

title: A crystal seed certified for an entire class of repulsions
pitch: Start a repulsive-particle simulation in a triangular crystal whose infinite-volume energy is optimal across many potentials.

title: An exact noise budget for an NPC choosing its best action
pitch: Put an exact ceiling on an NPC's average best Gaussian action score under a fixed total noise budget.

title: XOR interactions with a fixed budget across scales
pitch: Combine three cyclic interaction fields across dyadic scales with a certified total contribution budget.

title: Signed texture filtering with a turning-scale knob
pitch: Explore directional signed filtering when its sampling length tracks the field's turning rate.

title: Randomize dungeon graphs without changing room degrees
pitch: Shuffle a labeled network while preserving every room's link count, with a worst-case bound on how long to randomize it.

title: An oscillator that wakes only after an amplitude kick
pitch: Make a resting object begin sustained motion only after a sufficiently large kick.

title: Fractal density that counts overlapping maps correctly
pitch: Show how overlapping fractal addresses reduce spatial information instead of counting every address as distinct.

title: A graph rule that keeps reaction economies alive and bounded
pitch: Reject continuous reaction economies whose recipe graph lacks a structural guarantee against eventual extinction or runaway growth.

title: A sharp ceiling for one-bit clues in a noisy world
pitch: Put an exact information ceiling on a one-bit clue when independent world bits are corrupted by independent noise.

title: Polynomial degree as a bound on decision flicker
pitch: Give a degree-limited NPC decision rule a statistical ceiling on how often random sensor noise changes its answer.

title: A guaranteed Snaky opponent from a 39 KB certificate
pitch: Ship a small Snaky opponent with a certified win within 21 Maker moves.

title: A network puzzle with a certified crossing target
pitch: Give a complete-graph routing puzzle an exact crossing target.

title: Overlapping random branches with singular limiting mass
pitch: Examine a random branching distribution whose support fills an interval while its limiting mass is singular.

title: Predict the debris left by random triangle destruction
pitch: Predict the typical number of links left after uniformly deleting surviving triangles.

title: Choose a start with at least as many fresh two-hop options
pitch: Select a map start whose fresh two-hop destinations carry at least as much reward as its immediate destinations.

title: An exact board-size dial for cycle-or-clique puzzles
pitch: Set the exact completed-board size at which a cycle-or-clique avoidance puzzle becomes impossible.

title: An exact roughness knob for constrained random surfaces
pitch: Calibrate the large-scale roughness of an arrow-constrained random surface with a known formula instead of fitting its amplitude separately at every setting.

title: A fractal frontier whose animation clock survives refinement
pitch: Animate a critical square-lattice frontier with a traversal clock whose distribution stays consistent as the grid gets finer.

title: Keep random-map connectivity difficulty consistent across resolutions
pitch: Give random Voronoi terrain a connectivity slider calibrated across resolutions and comparable with a regular triangular board.

title: Terrain noise with exact covariance bands
pitch: Split Gaussian terrain into independent scale bands with an exact total covariance and finite-range band covariances.

title: A spin toy that exposes the cost of collective memory
pitch: Visualize how a dense critical spin system remembers earlier states, and compare that memory across system sizes and coupling distributions.

title: A procedural world that becomes tree-like above q = 4
pitch: Generate cycle-containing planar worlds whose large-scale distances approach a random tree when the FK weight is above four.

title: An exploratory constraint-jamming toy with certified target exponents
pitch: Explore a high-dimensional constraint system near jamming, with reference slopes for small gaps and weak normalized forces.

title: A precise noise knob for hidden-faction clues
pitch: Choose when distant, noisy clues can still reveal a hidden three-way faction, accounting for both branching and contrary rumors.

title: Wave traps that spend their binding budget optimally
pitch: Build the most efficient two-channel wave wells, and show why rotating their channels with position wastes binding budget.

title: Rough terrain with a hard slope limit and Gaussian large-scale statistics
pitch: Generate integer terraces with a hard one-step slope limit and study whether their large-scale averages look Gaussian.

title: Show why individually random cards can still form an unfair deck
pitch: Show that every card can have a fair position while the deck order remains extremely biased.

title: A disorder slider for lattice-wave interference
pitch: Explore how random site energies change wave spreading on a lattice.

title: Size-aware difficulty bands for random logic puzzles
pitch: Scale a random logic puzzle's satisfiability band with its size instead of keeping a fixed clause-density offset.

title: Noncrossing paths with a calibrated fractal footprint
pitch: Measure the footprint and multiscale density of uniformly sampled noncrossing tendrils.

title: Percolation in a world of binary-tree transformations
pitch: Explore randomly open connections between binary-tree transformations, with several large regions that need not join.

title: A quantum momentum cloud with a proved density knob
pitch: Draw a dilute quantum gas's condensate and momentum halo using a physically motivated density rule.

title: Entanglement survives two applications of explicit PPT noise
pitch: Show a concrete quantum noise channel whose repeated use leaves some entanglement intact.

title: Exact noisy-qubit capacity from one scalar search
pitch: Give a noisy-qubit communication puzzle a capacity meter computed by a one-variable search.

title: Temperature-sensitive magnetism with the first lattice correction
pitch: Replace an arbitrary temperature-strength curve with a low-temperature spin-wave magnetization curve.

title: A six-symbol puzzle with exactly three neutral measurement modes
pitch: Build three six-outcome measurement modes that erase knowledge when the player switches modes.

title: A classical optimizer for random, conflicting faction affinities
pitch: Optimize two factions with random, conflicting pair affinities using a message-passing method with an asymptotic guarantee.

title: Median-of-three diffusion for graph-driven game attributes
pitch: Smooth many graph-node attributes with an explicit nonlinear rule and a dimension-independent bound on how far values move versus how rough they remain.

title: A factor-two error certificate for coupled simulation filters
pitch: Tighten a numerical-range error certificate for polynomial linear filters from about 2.414 times scalar error to twice scalar error.

title: Hierarchical ability budgets from two recursive fields
pitch: Build a hierarchy-aware signed budget whose cost depends on where demands sit and how the two recursive capacity fields interact.

title: A periodic blob switches from ball to tube to slab
pitch: Generate a minimum-area object in a periodic cube and give a surface-relaxation solver an exact global target.

title: Fluid gates that move whole regions without compressing them
pitch: Route and reshape separate fluid regions through overlapping destinations while preserving volume throughout the motion.

title: A tiny moving hub can reassign a much larger crowd
pitch: Show why a slightly moved destination can make an optimal crowd allocator reassign many agents.

title: A positive shrinking geometry with exploding curvature
pitch: Animate an explicit shrinking radial core whose metric remains positive while its center curvature diverges.

title: Correct a dilute gas's particle count at the noise scale
pitch: Center a dilute excluded-volume gas's particle-count histogram correctly rather than shifting it by one noise scale.

title: A spectral steering field with no interior dead ends
pitch: Use a room's lowest nonconstant heat mode as a steering field with no continuum interior equilibrium.

title: Volumetric interpolation that controls the steepest slope
pitch: Interpolate a volumetric control field using a maximum-slope objective and inspect its interior gradient.
